decision: Stop both conditional-factor operators; no additional bank, gate-scale or conditional-factor variants.
reason: Coupled operator loses to bilateral on forward and gains on reverse, averaging slightly negative. It also averages slightly below the factorized control. Control gain averages nearzero. Neither supports a stable improved method with added history and calibration structure.
scope: One exposed expert bank and two correlated orders. No universal impossibility claim; no hard performance threshold invented.
next: Implement the shared native-complement hybrid in next_operator_draft.json with unprojected-hybrid and matched native-only controls.
